audit.whatIsWrong: Four chart rows disagreed with the packet and the mirror.
audit.why: Mirror (gragas__ornn) rewrote win[0] to Ornn, win[1] to Skill, win[3] to Ornn, win[4] to Gragas with matching phases sides; the packet chart is identical. 58% over 1250 games supports an Ornn-favoured lane with one Gragas window at 6.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 3, 4 flipped as one atomic group across both layers, with ratings and why-text moved with them.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as a shared stage on the strength of your own ultimate; it is Gragas's window.
audit.why: Explosive Cask is 100s at rank 1 and Body Slam 14s — the E-into-R flick lands before Call of the Forge God (140s) is even available.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why rewritten with both numbers; Body Slam's 14s written into breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entry credits Gragas's sustain to a 'Q pool' four separate times. Barrel Roll is a rolled cask that damages and slows; it has no heal and no pool. The heal is Happy Hour (P). Drunken Rage (W) — the damage reduction and the auto reset — was never named at all.
audit.why: packet.defects already flagged that this entry never names any Gragas ability. Riot's text: Q rolls a cask that slows, P 'periodically heals upon using a skill', W is a 1s drink granting bonus magic damage on the next attack and damage reduction.
audit.corrected: Sustain re-attributed to Happy Hour in whys[0], whys[1], wants.you[0], wants.foe[1]; Drunken Rage named as the auto reset in report[5].t and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns gave no durations and treated Drunken Rage as absent.
audit.why: Body Slam 14s is both his engage and his escape; Drunken Rage is 5s and is the burst tell.

edits.before: W brittle turns every trade into bonus %HP damage. Only take the trade when Gragas's Body Slam is down.
edits.after: Even stage — Happy Hour sustains his chip but Body Slam is 14s, so neither of you can commit yet.

edits.before: Call of the Forge God re-engages a whole fight — and your forge prints item leads. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Gragas's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Explosive Cask (100s) is his window: Body Slam in, then flick you under his tower or into his jungler before Call of the Forge God is up.

edits.before: - Gragas Body Slam: matchup-defining — His engage. E-knock up after it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Gragas Body Slam: 14s at rank 1, 12s maxed — his only engage and his only escape. - Drunken Rage: 5s, and it is an auto reset — the drink is the tell, not the hit. - Call of the Forge God: 140s — kill windows only.

edits.before: His engage. E-knock up after it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 14s at rank 1 — his only engage and only escape. Step up when it is gone.

edits.before: Track Gragas's Body Slam: His engage. E-knock up after it. When it is down — W-E + R him.
edits.after: Drunken Rage is an auto reset — the 1s drink is the tell. Body Slam 14s: step up after it.

edits.before: You're one of the weakest level-1s — no shield, no combo, mana-hungry — so just farm and let his Q-pool poke whiff on minions.
edits.after: Barrel Roll costs 80 mana at level 1 and only slows — your base stats and passive resistances win the walk-up, so take it.

edits.before: Even stage: he has Q sustain but no real burst yet, and you still lack your W shield to trade — neither of you wins this level.
edits.after: Even stage: Happy Hour heals him back off every cast, but Body Slam is 14s and neither of you has burst — nobody wins this level.

edits.before: Reach Level 3 and W-poke his max-HP through his Q-pool sustain
edits.after: Reach Level 3 and W-poke his max HP through Happy Hour's heal

edits.before: Sustain every poke with his Q pool and out-brawl you in extended AP fights
edits.after: Heal every poke back with Happy Hour and out-brawl you in extended fights

notes: The 'Q pool' error also appears in early ('his Q-pool sustain trades', 'his Q heal') and late ('his pool cooldown'). Those are long prose blocks where a single-phrase swap would sit inside the length band but I could not copy the surrounding text with confidence about how many other claims travel with it, so they are left for a second pass; the four short fields carrying the same error are fixed here. Gragas also has no 'pool' ability of any kind — the whole metaphor is imported from another champion.
